title: Recreate control-plane review-integrity mission
description: Implement the explicit external review-integrity requirements as a new mission. The failed v3 mission remains immutable history. Require trusted external review artifacts and truthful report/commit provenance before archival.
acceptanceCriteria: A completed mission cannot self-approve and only a trusted external artifact may advance it.
Review transitions and verification/provenance evidence are durable and truthful.
The failed v3 mission is not modified.
